claims.claim: Artifact-only FAILURE affinity validates canonical FAILURE/RUN identity and original TASK/base/head ancestry and affinity without fabricating a candidate ref.
Freshness reuses that lineage proof, recognizes authentic artifact-only failures as UNRESOLVED, and retains exact canonical repair and TASK-supersession resolution checks.

Missing candidates require validated nontransportable EXECUTION failures; present candidates remain bound to the failed head. RESULT candidate requirements and fail-closed identity, conflict, route and ref-race checks are retained.
Changes remain within permitted attention, freshness and test files, reuse existing privacy validators, preserve selector APIs, and add no lifecycle authority or state store.
Artifact-only events use the existing durable inbox, lane lock, duplicate suppression and proof-only ambiguous-delivery safeguards without changing the delivery state machine.

Added source and integration fixtures cover absent/present candidates, invalid lineage and routes, conflicting refs, races, exact successors, and locked, duplicate, deferred and ambiguous wake delivery; existing historical and workflow tests remain intact.
